醉生梦死（多信息位）: In a drunken haze (many info roles)
信息位充足、新老玩家皆宜，邪恶方建议交给有经验的玩家: Plenty of information, good for new and experienced players alike; give the evil team to experienced players.
醉酒位可灵活调整，多留黄昏私聊时间给恶魔和爪牙: The Drunk's seat is flexible; leave plenty of private chat time at dusk for the Demon and Minions.
醉酒的图书管理员给出假外来者信息替恶魔打掩护，间谍拿魔典信息，讲故事空间大: The drunk Librarian gives false Outsider information that covers for the Demon, and the Spy has the Grimoire. Lots of room for storytelling.
醉酒调查员给出错误爪牙信息，信息位不多，投毒者不失误便容易进决赛圈: The drunk Investigator gives wrong Minion information; with few information roles, a careful Poisoner can easily reach the final three.
只有占卜师每夜主动查验，恶魔伪装难被聚焦，好人需靠夜间死亡信息推理；酒鬼也可放厨: Only the Fortune Teller actively checks each night, so the Demon's bluff is hard to pin down; good must reason from night deaths. The Drunk can also go on the Chef.
图书管理员指出杀手/共情者中有酒鬼，隐士被当作好人误导，焦点在“谁是酒鬼”: The Librarian says the Drunk is the Slayer or the Empath, and the Recluse misleads by reading as good. It all comes down to "who is the Drunk?"
圣徒是占卜师的干扰项，醉酒调查员再给假信息，专门让圣徒背锅；邪恶方宜伪装外来者: The Saint is the Fortune Teller's red herring and the drunk Investigator adds false information, all so the Saint takes the blame; evil should bluff Outsiders.
醉酒共情者首夜报错、圣徒是占卜干扰项，胜负常取决于圣徒会不会被处决: The drunk Empath reports wrongly on night one and the Saint is the red herring; the game often turns on whether the Saint gets executed.
醉酒占卜师搅局、间谍提供魔典信息，恶魔可精准刀人，好人宜前期少处决多分析: A drunk Fortune Teller muddies things and the Spy supplies Grimoire information, so the Demon can kill precisely; good should execute less early and analyse more.
管理员喝多了: The Librarian had one too many
醉酒图书管理员误导开局，隐士对共情者显示为善良，贞洁者是占卜干扰项，好人需少处决: A drunk Librarian misleads at the start, the Recluse reads as good to the Empath, and the Virgin is the red herring; good should execute sparingly and judge by night deaths.
无外来者的标准局，恶魔可伪装外来者假装有男爵，贞洁者为占卜干扰项: A standard game with no Outsiders; the Demon can bluff an Outsider to fake a Baron, and the Virgin is the red herring.
新手向男爵局，邪恶方可冒充外来者，酒鬼可放杀手或送葬者: A beginner Baron game; evil can pose as Outsiders, and the Drunk can go on the Slayer or Undertaker.
红唇女郎提高邪恶容错，好人信息较可靠，市长是翻盘点；士兵或市长当占卜干扰项: The Scarlet Woman gives evil room for error, good's information is fairly reliable, and the Mayor is the comeback; the Soldier or Mayor is the red herring.
间谍+投毒者组合，邪恶可精准击杀信息位并假造男爵，好人后期靠市长翻盘: Spy plus Poisoner: evil can kill the information roles precisely and fake a Baron; good comes back late through the Mayor.
醉酒共情者帮两侧爪牙隐藏，但厨师信息对恶魔很致命，恶魔需由老手担任；圣徒为干扰项: A drunk Empath hides the Minions on either side, but the Chef's information is deadly for the Demon, so give the Demon to a veteran; the Saint is the red herring.
图书管理员开局点出两大信息位中有酒鬼，说书人让两者信息互相矛盾制造戏剧性，不建议: The Librarian reveals at the start that one of the two big information roles is the Drunk, and the Storyteller makes their information contradict for drama. Not for beginners.
醉酒厨师报假连坐，真贞洁者可被邪恶主动撞来误导，守鸦人或贞洁者当占卜干扰项: The drunk Chef reports false pairs, evil can deliberately bump into the real Virgin to mislead, and the Ravenkeeper or Virgin is the red herring.
共情者、调查员和占卜师的信息都指向圣徒，好人要辨别圣徒真假；投毒者须经验丰富: The Empath, Investigator and Fortune Teller all point at the Saint, and good must work out whether the Saint is real; the Poisoner needs to be experienced.
醉酒调查员报假投毒者，男爵在场，恶魔还可伪装外来者进一步混淆: The drunk Investigator names a false Poisoner, the Baron is in play, and the Demon can bluff an Outsider for extra confusion.
灾祸滋生11人局复盘（实战配置）: Trouble Brewing 11-player recap (from a real game)
实战复盘配置：投毒者盲毒调查员，红唇女郎跳圣徒假造男爵，恶魔与红唇先后自刀拖到胜: From a real game: the Poisoner blindly poisoned the Investigator, the Scarlet Woman claimed Saint to fake a Baron, and the Demon and Scarlet Woman each killed themselves in turn to drag it out to victory.
四外来者男爵局，醉酒调查员故意报假男爵位，圣徒是占卜干扰项，对好人很不友好: A four-Outsider Baron game: the drunk Investigator deliberately names a false Baron and the Saint is the red herring. Very unfriendly to good.
新手向标准局，洗衣妇首夜替醉酒共情者“证身”，恶魔伪装宜给市长+士兵: A beginner standard game: on night one the Washerwoman "confirms" the drunk Empath; the Demon's bluffs should be Mayor and Soldier.
三名邪恶连坐但醉酒厨师报无连坐，邪恶方宜拿调查员伪装去污蔑他人，进阶局: Three evil players sit together but the drunk Chef reports no pairs; evil should take the Investigator bluff to frame others. For advanced games.
间谍和投毒者的高光时刻: The Spy and Poisoner's finest hour
双方较均衡：送葬者醉酒、士兵为干扰项，邪恶可装外来者或毒信息位，好人可走市长胜利: Fairly balanced: the Undertaker is drunk and the Soldier is the red herring; evil can bluff Outsiders or poison information roles, and good can go for a Mayor win.
醉酒占卜师、圣徒为干扰项，强信息少，靠僧侣保护和送葬者锁定身份: The drunk Fortune Teller and the Saint are red herrings; there is little strong information, so good leans on the Monk's protection and the Undertaker to pin down roles.
醉酒厨师报无连坐干扰判断，隐士显示为善良，好人可靠士兵和僧侣保市长取胜: The drunk Chef reports no pairs to throw off reasoning and the Recluse reads as good; good can win by keeping the Mayor alive with the Soldier and Monk.
醉酒图书管理员报“无外来者”，场上却有男爵和隐士，好人需在两人间取舍；有僧侣与较: The drunk Librarian reports "no Outsiders", yet the Baron and Recluse are in play, so good must choose between them; there is a Monk and plenty of information.
核心是间谍：图书管理员、调查员和占卜师的信息让间谍身份扑朔迷离；原文称可视局势加: It all revolves around the Spy: the Librarian, Investigator and Fortune Teller make the Spy's identity murky; the source says a Drunk can be added if needed.
无外来者、邪恶有两对连坐但场上没有厨师，可把厨师给恶魔当伪装，送葬者为干扰项: No Outsiders, and evil has two adjacent pairs but there is no Chef, so give the Chef to the Demon as a bluff; the Undertaker is the red herring.
醉酒僧侣守护无效、圣徒为占卜干扰项，中后期易出意外；邪恶宜拿一套外来者伪装: The drunk Monk's protection does nothing and the Saint is the red herring, so surprises come mid to late game; evil should take a set of Outsider bluffs.
醉酒调查员报假男爵，恶魔方至少拿两个外来者伪装去扰乱信息: The drunk Investigator names a false Baron, and the evil team takes at least two Outsider bluffs to scramble the information.
醉酒图书管理员报无外来者，恶魔再穿外来者伪装让好人以为有男爵；僧侣为占卜干扰项: The drunk Librarian reports no Outsiders, then the Demon bluffs an Outsider so good thinks there's a Baron; the Monk is the red herring.
醉酒共情者反复报两侧有邪恶，坑害僧侣和隐士；调查员报男爵让好人意识到有酒鬼，后期: The drunk Empath keeps reporting evil neighbours, framing the Monk and Recluse; the Investigator naming a Baron makes good realise there is a Drunk, so a late comeback is possible.
醉酒厨师报三对连坐误导好人，恶魔要设法冒充市长，送葬者为占卜干扰项: The drunk Chef reports three pairs to mislead good, the Demon has to find a way to pose as the Mayor, and the Undertaker is the red herring.
最直白的一套。说书人要把握和平主义者、修补匠、沙巴洛斯反刍的时机。: The most straightforward set. The Storyteller must time the Pacifist, the Tinker and the Shabaloth's regurgitation well.
冒险换信息，整合信息抓僵怖；修补匠、月之子、教父制造额外死亡。: Trade risk for information and combine it to catch the Zombuul; the Tinker, Moonchild and Godfather cause extra deaths.
刺客和普卡能杀本来不会死的人；疯子以为自己是恶魔。: The Assassin and Pukka can kill players who otherwise couldn't die; the Lunatic thinks they are the Demon.
双方都有很多保命手段，死人还可能复活。: Both sides have many ways to stay alive, and the dead might even come back.
珀一夜多杀，主谋让恶魔被处决后还多一天；侍臣是关键。: The Po kills several in one night, and the Mastermind gives an extra day after the Demon is executed; the Courtier is the key.
进阶向：僵怖+教父，教父让外来者减为一名（疯子），六名镇民偏保护与信息: Advanced: Zombuul plus Godfather; the Godfather cuts the Outsiders to one (the Lunatic), and the six Townsfolk lean towards protection and information.
信息好算好懂。说书人记住谁被诅咒、谁被诺-达鲺毒着就够了。: Information is easy to work out and understand. The Storyteller only has to remember who is cursed and who the No Dashii is poisoning.
舞蛇人、方古让恶魔换人，麻脸巫婆和理发师改角色；呆瓜要在一片混乱里挑出好人。: The Snake Charmer and Fang Gu move the Demon around, while the Pit-Hag and Barber change characters; the Klutz must pick out a good player in the chaos.
围绕双子的真假；亡骨魔可以杀掉双子留住能力。别只顾双子忘了找恶魔。: Built around which twin is real; the Vigormortis can kill a twin and keep the ability. Don't get so caught up in the twins that you forget to find the Demon.
诺-达鲺有很多下毒目标；博学者、数学家够聪明就能看出谁中毒。适合善思的玩家。: The No Dashii has many poisoning targets; a sharp Savant or Mathematician can spot who is poisoned. For thoughtful players.
涡流让关键信息全错，洗脑师和畸形秀演员带来疯狂。开局前先讲清楚疯狂怎么判。: The Vortox makes key information wrong, and the Cerenovus and Mutant bring madness. Explain how madness is judged before the game starts.
